brtan pa dang / /bsdu ba rten dang gya nom pa'i/ /dngos po sbyin dang gsad bya ba/ /thar bar byed dang dge ba ni/ /yang dag blangs ba spel la sogs/ /sgrub byed rgyu yi mtshan nyid de/ /mdo las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin/ /tshig le'ur byas pa 'di gnyis ni gong nyid du mtshan bshad par bkrol zin pas yang mi bri'o/ /de ltar mtshan rnams brjod nas/ mdo las gsungs pa'i dpe byad bzang po rnams bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis kyis gsungs pa/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang / /mdog snum mtho dang sor mo rnams/ /zlum rgyas byin gyis phra ba dang / /rtsa mi mngon dang mdud pa med/ /long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang / /seṅge glang chen bya dang ni/ /khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang / /mdzes gshegs drang dang 'khril bag chags/ /byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham/ /gtsang dang 'jam dang dag pa'i sku/ /mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /sku yi kho lag yangs shing bzang / /goms snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni/ /dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang / /sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang / /shin tu grimasapa'i sku nyid dang / /yan lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang / /gzigs pa sgrib med dag pa dang / /dku zlum skabs phyin ma rnyongs dang / /phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni/ /zab dang g.yas phyogasa'akhyil ba dang / /

)lko/ /kun nas blta na sdug pa dang / /kun spyod gtsang dang sku la ni/ /sne ba gnag bag med pa dang / /phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang / /phyag ring mdangs yod zab ring dang 'al ri ta cang mi shāng dang / /mchu ni bim pa ltar dmar dang / /ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang / /ngache/ra dang 'brug gi sgra nyid dang / /gsung mnyen 'jam dang mche ba /zlam/ //rtso dang 8kar dang mnyam pa da/ / / (/byin rgyas phra dang shangs mtho dang / /mchog tu dag pa dag dang ni/ /spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /padma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba dang / /smin tshugs ring dang 'jam the dang / /snam daji spya /ni mnyam pa sdong / /nazlos ṭā rnamyu par spangs pa dang / /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa dang / /dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang / /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag dang / /sdug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzings ldang / sa/sri ga ra dri 'itsha ches bu khro/ /yad na 'phrog par byed pa dang / /dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ /ces pa'i don/ mdo dang rtsa ba dang 'grel pa so sor par /ba ri/ de /zhin ga brjo pa'i ngape byad bzang po brgyad cu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni mngon dir 'dubyab thams cad las dben pas sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bur 'dug pa yinasta zhes pa'i don// 'du /da /mas cardo la

'dod chags dang bral ba nyid kyis sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni bshes gnyen byams pa dang 'dra bar sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i thugs mnga' bas sen mo'i mdog snum pa yin zhes pa'i don/ sems can la phan pa lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid kyis sen mo mdog snum pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rigs dang rgyud mthon por byung bas sen mo mtho ba yin zhes pa'i don/rigs kyi mchog las skyes pas sen mo mtho ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni tshul kha na ma tho ba mi mnga' bas/ sor mo zlum pa yin zhes pa'i don/ tshul kha na ma tho ba med pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams zlum pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tshogs pas sor mo rgyas pa yin zhes pa'i don/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams rgyas pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rim gyis grub pas sor mo rim gyis gzhol ba yin zhes pa'i don/ yang dag par mthar gyis zhugs pa nyid kyis sor mo rnams byin gyis phra ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sku dang gsung dang sku'i 'phrin las dang 'tsho ba shin tu dben pas rtsa mi mngon pa yin zhes pa'i don/ lus la sogs pa'i las dang 'tsho ba rab tu bsrungs ba nyid kyis rtsa mi mngon pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa las grol bas rtsa la

gnya/ /mdud pa med pa yin zhes pa'i don/ nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa 'grol ba nyid kyis rtsa mdud pa med pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni shin ta dben pa'i chos mnga' bas long bu mi mngor pa yir 'es pa'i don/ shin tu sbas pa'i chos kyi blo gros can nyid kyis long bu mi mngon pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mi mnyam pa thams cad las rtsol bas snabazlo tsu marnyim pa med pa yin 'es pa'i ngor/ /song /matā ba'i gnas thams cad las skye bo dgrol bar mdzad pa nyid kyis zhabs mi mnyam pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mi'i saṅges seṅge'i 'grothe su bzhab pa yin zhe pa'i do// mi /zi/ gyis sgomar pa 'a grum/kha/ /pa nyid kyis seṅge'i stabs su gshegs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mi'i glang pos glang pa'i 'gros su bzhud pa yin zhes pa'i don/ klu zil gyis |non pa rme rmekhas pa snye/ kyis gang po che'i //shā su gshegs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni ngang pa'i rgyal po ltar nam mkha' la bzhud pas ngang pa'i ltabs su bzhud pa yin zhes pa'i don/ nam mkha' la gshegs par mkhas pa nyid skyes ngang lapa'i stobs rnyi gsheg/ pa 'ing dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mi'i khyu mchog gis khyu mchog gi stabs su bzhud pa yin zhes pa'i don/ skyes bu'i khyu mchog tu mkhas pa nyid kyis khyu mchog gi stabs su gsherges pa nyid dang /ta sangs nyis /rnams sne /

mthun pa'i lam mnga' bas g.yas phyogs su bzhud pa yin no zhes pa'i don/ skor phyogs kyi lam dang mthun par gshegs pa nyid kyis g.yas phyogs ldog cing gshegs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni blta na mdzes pas mdzes par bzhud pa yin zhes pa'i don/ mdzes par mkhas pa nyid kyis mdzes par gshegs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rtag tu yon po mi mnga' bas ma yol bar bzhud pa yin zhes pa'i don/rtag tu sems gya gyu mi mnga' ba nyid kyis mi yor bar gshegs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni tshul rnam par dag pa'i yon tan ston pas sku shin tu legs pa yin zhes pa'i don/ yon tan yang dag par brjod par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku 'khril bag chags pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sdig pa'i chos thams cad shin tu sbyangs pas sku shin tu sbyangs pa yin zhes pa'i don/ sdig pa'i chos dang ma 'bags pa nyid kyis sku byi dor byas pa lta bu nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni chos rim gyis ston pas sku rim gyis gzhol ba yin zhes pa'i don/ gdul bya dang 'tshams par chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis sku rim par 'tshams pa nyid dang /sangs rgyas rnams ni sku dang gsung dang thugs gtsang ba dang ldan pas sku shin tu gtsang ba yin zhes pa'i don/ sku la sogs pa kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba'i phyir rnam par dag pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rang

༄༅/ /bzhin gyis thugs 'jam pa dang ldan pas sku shin tu 'jam pa yin zhes pa'i don/ thugs thugs rje can gyi phyir sku 'jam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rngams ni rang bzhin gyis snam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' bas sku shin tu rnam par dag pa yin zhes pa'i don/ thugs rnam par dag pa'i phyir sku rnam par dag pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rngams ni chos dang 'al ba shitna ta rdzogs pas (pe byang /shin 6 〉sgos pa yi1 zhes pa'i don/ chos 'dul ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir mtshan rdzogs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni yon tan yangs shing bzarngo ba rtson pas ska che rlung mdze/ tpa 0yin nis pa'i ldan/ / //shā 〉( mdzes pa/'i yon tan the gas pa'i phyir sku'i kho lag yangs shing bzang ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i thugs ma('a bas hūṃ legs par mnyam pa khron zhes /'o don/ thams cad la thugs snyoms pa'i phyir sgom pa snyoms pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni gzigs pa shin tu rnam par dag pas spyan rnam par dag pa yin zhes pa'i don/ rngam par dag pa'i chos /ston pa'i /skyer/ par rgyom khrir nga pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni shin tu 'jam pa'i chos ston pas sku shin tu gzhon pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos go sla ba ston pa'i phyir hūṃ shin tu rgernon pho can nyirdo /nga / sangarmi skyis rnams ni kta sdu zhum pa / /

med pa'i thugs mnga' bas sku zhum pa med pa yin zhes pa'i don/ thugs rtag tu ma zhum pa'i phyir sku zhus pa med pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang bas/ sku shin tu rgyas pa yin zhes pa'i don/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par 'phags pa'i phyir sku rgyas pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni yang 'byung ba shin tu bcom zhing zad pas sku shin tu mkhregs pa yin zhes pa'i don/ yang srid zad pa nyid kyis sku shin tu grims pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rten cing 'brel ba'i yan lag dang nying lag legs par ston pas yan lag dang nying lag spa bar mdzes pa yin zhes pa'i don/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba shin tu rnam par phye ba ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis/ yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byes pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni gzigs pa shin tu dag pas snang ba rab rib med cing rnam par dag pa yin zhes pa'i don/ tshig gi don shin tu rnam par dag pa ston pas gzigs pa rab rib med cing rnam par dag pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni tshul dang mthun pa'i slob ma mnga' bas phyal zlum pa yin zhes pa'i don/ slob ma tshul khrims phun sum tshogs par gyur pa nyid kyis dku zlum pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad shin tu sbyangs pa ste phyal shin tu byang ba dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i

༄༅/ /don / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma sbags pa nyid kyis dku skabs phyin pa yin pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni nga rgyal gyi de'u bcom pas phyal ma zhom pa yin zhes pa'i don/ nga rgyal gyi 'gying bag bcom pa nyid kyis dku ma rnyongs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni chos zad pa rnam par bzlog pas phyal phyam mer 'dug pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos zad pa rnam par bzlog pa nyid kyis phyal phyang nge ba nyid dang /sangs rgyas rnams ni chos zab mo shin tu thugs su chud pas lte ba zab pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos zab mo rtogs pa nyid kyis lte ba zab pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mthun pa'i slob ma mnga' bas lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba yin zhes pa'i don/ slob ma mthun par gyur pa nyid kyis lte ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni slob ma kun nas mdzes pa'i dge 'dun mnga' bas kun nas mdzes pa yin zhes pa'i don/ 'khor kun nas mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis kun nas mdzes pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thugs shin tu gtsang ba dang ldan pas kun tu spyod pa shin tu gtsang ba yin zhes pa'i don/thugs gtsang ba nyid kyis kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams nag po bstan pa dang bral ba'i chos dang 'dul ba mnga' bas sku la sme ba med pa yin zhes pa'i don/ dus ma yin pa'i chos 'dul ba

dang bral ba nyid kyis sku la sme ba dang gnag bag med pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni shing bal ltar rab tu yang ba rab tu ston pa'i chos thob pas phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa yin zhes pa'i don/ lus la sogs pa zo mdog bde ba 'thob pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rang gi skye bo dang skye bo phal la byams pas dge sbyong chen po brnyes pas phyag gi ri mo snum pa yin zhes pa'i don/ mdangs yod pa'i dge sbyong chen po brnyes pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo mdangs yod pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni shin tu zab cing brtan par zhugs pas phyag gi ri mo zab pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos zab mo la gnas pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo zab tre nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni bzod pa'i chos yangs pa bstan pas phyag gi ri mo ring ba yin zhes pa'i don/ phyi rjes su yang dag par yongs su dag pa'i chos ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag gi ri mo ring ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni bslab pa'i gnas ha cang yang mi ring bar 'cha' bas zhal ha cang yang mi ring ba yin zhes pa'i don/ bslab pa rab tu mang po kun nas ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis zhal ha cang mi ring ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni gzugs brnyan 'jig rten du bkye bas zhal gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yin zhes pa'i don/

ra༅/ /'jig rten thams cad du gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar rtogs pa nyid kyis mchu bim pa ltar dmar ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jam pa sngon da btang zhing lal bas lngags shin ta 'jam pa yin zhes pa'i don/ tshig 'jam pos 'dul ba nyid kyis ljags mnyen pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni yon tan phra ba'i tshogs dang ldan pas ljags shin tu srab raṃ yin zhe/ pa'ing don/ rtse( tan/ /snang pa mang ba / nyid kyis ljags srab pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni byis pa so sa'i skye bo 'dod chags pa rnams kyis chos dang 'dul ba gting dpag par dka' bas ljags shin rte demar ba skre zhes pa'i khron/ /sa la la ba byis pa'i skye bo chags pa can gyis gting dpag dka' ba nyid kyis ljags dmar ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni glang pa'i sgra dang 'brug gi sgra lta bus brtsengs pa ཿmi rminga' bas gang pa'i nga ro daji /'dag gi dbyings dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba nyid kyis 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas nyid ni snyan cing 'jam pa dang nyams su (de bar smra ba'i slob ma samanga' bas stsawa ci/ 'ji/ shā ngang nyams su bde ba'i gsung dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ snyan pa la sogs par gsung pa nyid kyis gsung snyan cing mnyen la 'jam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni srid par kun tu sbyor shā zlos 'da' bas /

tshems che ba shin tu zlum pa yin zhes pa'i don/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba bsdoms pa nyid kyis mche ba zlum pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni skye bo rno ba rnams 'dul bas tshems mche ba sno ba dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don / skye bo gdul dka' ba 'dul bar mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba rno ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni chos dang 'dul ba dka' bas tshems mche ba shin tu dkar ba yin zhes pa'i don/ chos 'dul ba shin tu dkar ba nyid kyis mche ba dkar ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sa'i phyogs mnyam pa la bzhugs pas mche ba mnyam pa la zhugs pa ste mche ba mnyam pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ mnyam pa'i sa la gnas pa nyid kyis mche ba mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rim gyis mngon par rtogs pa'i chos ston pas tshems mche ba rim gyis gzhol ba yin zhes pa'i don/ mthar gyis mngon par rtogs pa yang dag par rab tu ston par mdzad pa nyid kyis mche ba byin gyis phra ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni shes rab kyi ri bo mthon po la bzhugs pas shangs legs par mtho ba dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ shes rab mchog la gnas pa nyid kyis shangs mtho ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni 'du ba'i skye po gtsang ma mnga' bas shangs shin tu gtsang ba yin zhes pa'i don/ skye bo gtsang ba phun sum tshogs pa nyid kyis shangs gtsang ba nyid

༄tsho/ /dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos phul du yangs pa mnga' bas spyan ring ba dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos shin tu rgya che ba'i phyir spyan yangs pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sems can gyi tshogs shin tu bsags pas rdzi ma sdug pa yin zhes pa'i don/ sems can gyi tshogs drangs pa nyid kyis rdzi ma sdug pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni lha dang lha ma yin dang skyes bu dang na chung mchog mig dkar nag 'byes shing / palha'i 'dab ma ltar 'dug pa rnams kyis mngon par dga' bar bya bas spyan dkar nag 'byes shing palha'i 'dab ma ltar 'dug pa yin zhes pa'i don/ spyan dkar nag 'phya sa shing padma'i 'dab ma rangs pa lta bu nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rtag tu yangs pa gzigs pas smin ma ring ba dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ rtag tu phyi rjes su gzigs pa nyid kyis smin tshugs ring ba nyid dang /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'jam par 'dul ba la mkhas pas smin ma 'jam pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ chos 'dul ba 'jam po la mkhas pa nyid kyis smin ma 'jam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba'i snam gyis sems can snum par 'gyur ba'i skye bo 'dul bas smin ma snum pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ thugs kyi rgyud dge bas brlan pa nyid kyis smin ma snum pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni skyon

thams cad mkhyen pas smin ma'i spu mnyam pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ kun tu skyon gzigs pa nyid kyis smin ma'i spu mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni chos mchog tu yangs shing don dang ldan pa mnga' bas snyan shal legs shing snyan shal ring ba yin zhes pa'i don/ mchog tu gnod pa bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis phyag ring zhing rgyas pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni nyon mongs pa'i rgyud las rnam par rgyal bas snyan mnyam pa yin zhes pa'i don/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba nyid kyis snyan mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni sems can bsam pa ma nyams pa 'dul bas snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud ma nyams par mdzad pa nyid kyis snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su sbyangs bas zhal dpral ba legs par grub pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ lta bas byas pa thams cad kyis gzhan du mi 'gyur ba nyid kyis dpral ba legs par 'byed pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni phas kyi rgol ba shin tu 'dul bas zhal dpral ba yangs pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ smra ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa nyid kyis dpral dbyes che ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni smon lam dam pa shin tu rdzogs pas

༄༅/ /dbu shen tu rgyas pa yen zhes pa'i don/ smon lam gyi mchog yongs su rdzogs pa nyid kyis dbu shin tu rgyas pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni yul gyi bung ba rnam par bzlog pas dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa dang ldan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ yul gyi dga' ba bzlog par mdzad pa nyid kyis dbu ska bung ba ltar gnag pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mthong ba dang sgom pas spang bar bya ba bag la nyal ba zad par byas pas dbu skra sdug pa yin zhes pa'i don/ mthong ba dang sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i bag rme nyal spangs pa'i phyir dbu skra sdug pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni thugs 'jam pas bstan pa'i snying po thugs su chud pas dbu skra 'jam pa yin zhes pa'i don/ bstan pa blo 'jam pos yongs su shes pa nyid kyis dbu skra 'jam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni rtag tu ma 'khrug pa'i thugs dang ldan pas dbu skra mi 'dzings pa yin zhes pa'i don/ thugs 'dod chags la sogs pas ma 'khrugs pa nyid kyis dbu skra ma 'dzings pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni brlang ba'i gsung dang yongs su bral bas dbu skra mi rtsub pa yin zhes pa'i don/rtag tu tshig mi rtsub pa nyid kyis dbu skra mi gshor ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag spos kyi me tog gis skye bo mthun par sgrub pas dbu skra dri zhim pa yin zhes pa'i don/ byang chub kyi yan lag

gi me tog bkram pa nyid kyis dbu skra dri zhim pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas rnams ni phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis dang g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa yin zhes pa'i don/ rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par gyur pa nyid kyis phyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u bkra shisadang g.yung drung 'khyil pas brgyan pa nyid yin no/ /rab 'byor de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'o/ /de ltar sku gsum pa bstan nas/ bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku byis pa'i skye bo thams cad dang thun mong ba'i dbang du byas te/ rab 'byor gzhan yang yum la slob na chos de dag thams cad rtogs par byas nas bla med byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med mtha' med par dus thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sprin gyis sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa de ltar/ byang sems chen pos yum la bslab par bya'o zhes pa'i don/ gang gis srid pa ji srid pa/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces pa'i don/ shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i gzugs gang gis 'khor ba ji srid 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ sems can rnams kyi byu

༄༅/ /'dod pa'i don mnyam pa nyid du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ rgyun chags pa nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sprul pa'i sku rgyun mi 'chad pa yin no/ /'grel chen las/ kye dge slong dag mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba 'di la ni sku dam pa yang dag pa'i rdul phra rab bsags pa'i rang bzhin bden pa nyid du ma 'dzin par zhes bya ba'i bsgrub par bya ba'i chos gsungs pa yin no/ /dge slong dag nga ni byu chos kyi skus yongs su rdzogs par te sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mngon sum du byas pa'i sgrub par byed pas yongs su rdzogs par ltos shig ces bya ba 'dis ni gtan tshigs gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di yang yang dag pa'i mthas rab tu phye ba chos kyi sku'i yongs su rdzogs par byed pas yongs su rdzogs par byas pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/ yum mo zhes bya ba de'i rang bzhin te 'dis ni phyogs kyi chos nye bar bsdu ba byas so/ /'dis ni 'di skad du/ gang zhig sgyu ma lta bu'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgom pa'i sgrub par byed pas yongs su rdzogs par byas pa de ni chos kyi sku yin te/ dper na sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi lta bu'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'di yang ci skad du brjod pa'i ye shes sgom pa'i sgrub par byed pas yongs su rdzogs par byas pa yin no zhes rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs brjod pa yin no/ /

don ni shin tu lkog tu gyur pa nyid yin pas rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa la sogs pas gzung bar mi nus pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni rang rig pa'i mngon sum du grub ste rmi lam la sogs pa'i shes pa dang 'dra bar don gyi rnam pas nye bar sgrub pa sgom par bya'o zhes bya bar gnas so/ /de yang brjod zin pa'i tshul dang gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang bral bas de kho na nyid du dngos po med pa nyid du na sgyu ma lta bu nyid du nges so/ /de bas na 'di yid kyis sgom pa'i stobs kyis gsal bar snang ba gang yin pa de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin pas gtan tshigs ma grub pa ma yin no/ /mthun pa'i phyogs la yod pas 'gal ba yang ma yin te sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi sku khas len pa las 'di dper byas pa yin no/ /gzhan dag la yang chos kyi sku med na tshad ma'i gnod pa dang bral ba can ci skad du bshad pa'i ye shes sgom pa'i sgrub par byed pas yongs su rdzogs par byas pa dang bral ba'i phyir 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa dang 'dra bar phyin ci log dang ldan par thal bar 'gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni phyin ci ma log par ske 'dod pa yin no zhes bya ba ni bzlog na gnod pa can gyi tshad ma yin no/ /rdul phra rab rnams mi 'thad pa'i phyir gtan tshigs ma nges pa nyid kyang ma yin no/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs kyi sku mtshan

༄༅/ /dang dpe byad 'bar ba dang ldan pa sems can skal ba can rnams kyis mthong ba 'di ni ston pa'i de kho na nyid kyi chos kyi sku ma yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang mchog tu dri ma med pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa'i tshogs dang ldan pa chos kyi sku'i dbang gis de rnams kyi rang gi shes pa de lta bu'i gzugs kyi sku'i rnam par so sor snang ste/ rang gi shes pa de bzhin gshegs par snang ba'i ngo bor ma shes pa dag 'di ni phyi rol gyi bcom ldan 'das yin no zhes ston pa'i blos rnam par rtog cing / lta ba dang phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pas mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i snod du 'gyur ba'i rim gyis log par so sor snang ba yin kyang /mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam par rtog pa bzhin du dngos po dang 'brel bas rnam par rtog pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pas phan pa'i rgyu nyid du 'gyur bar mthong ba kho na ste myur du ni ma yin no/ /gang gi phyir ce srid dngos po la mngon par zhen pas shes bya la shes pa kun tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba de srid du de ma yin la der 'dzin pas shes pa de 'khrus pas de kho na mthong ba las thag ring ba yin no/ /de bas na ci ltar sgyu ma mkhan rnams rang gis sprul pa'i glang po che la sogs pa dngos po lta bur snang ba rnams la dngos po'i rang bzhin du mi rtog pas mngon par zhen pa med pa de bzhin du 'di dag ni bden pa nyid do zhes mngon par zhen par mi byed

do / /de bzhin lan mang du thabs mang pos dus yun ring por theg pa chen po'i rang gi ngo po la ma bslabs pa'i las dang po par gyur pa myur du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas skabs thob par 'dod pas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang gis byung ba rang gis shes pa'i gzugs brnyan gzugs kyi sku'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba'i bla ma la mngon par zhen pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa snying por gyur pas dad par bya'o zhes so// / rgya gar skad du/ ārya kā ya tri su tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sku gsum gyi mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khyab bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs med pa dang / lha dang klu dang / 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la bkur sti bgyid cing mchod do/ /de'i tshe de'i 'khor der byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po 'dug pa stan las langs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das la sku du mnga'/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sa'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pa la sku gsum mnga' ste/ chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum ni

༄7/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ni chos kyi sku'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /spyod pa rnam par dag pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgrul pa'i sku'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku ni nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don to/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni sprin ltar 'byung ba'i don to/ /sprul pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las te char ba lta bus thams cad spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsum bshad pa ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum ni 'di ltar blta bar bya'o/ /chos kyi sku ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo gang la blta bar bya'o/ /longs zlod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngo gang la snang ngo / /sprul pa'i sku ni mos pa spyod pa'i so so'i skye bo'i ngo gang la snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos kyi sku ni sangs rgyas thams ricad dang rang bzhin mthun par gnas so/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas tharmes cad dang ting nge 'dzin mthun par gnas so/ /sprul pa'i sku ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang 'phrin las mthun pa'i don to/ /rigs kyi bu kun

gzhi gnas su dag pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te chos kyi sku'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i yid gnas su dag pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas su dag pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /rnam par shes pa lnga yongs su dag pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te sprul pa'i sku'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la dam pa'i chos thos pa ni rab tu legs so/ /bde bar bshegs pa rab tu legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag rab tu 'dzin pa des bsod nams tshad med pa dang / brjod du med pa dang / grangs med pa dang / dpag tu med pa 'thob bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sku gsum gyi mdo rdzogs so/ /de ltar ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bdag nyid can rgyu sbyor bzhi bsgoms pa'i stobs las byung ba/ yul can sangs rgyas dang byang sems 'phags pa dang so skye las dag gi yul nyid du/ ngo bo gnas ma lus pa gnas gyur pa'i ye

༄༅/ /shes sde tshan nyer gcig la ltos nas chos sku dang / sogs pa gnas 'og min kho nar bzhugs shing mtshan dang dpe byad gsal la rdzogs pas brgyan pa'i gzugs sku la ltos nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs su gdul bya sna tshogs la chos sna tshogs ston pa'i gzugs sku la ltos nas sprul skur rab tu brtags pa'i sku gsum bstan nas/ kun rdzob tu ye shes kho nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la sogs par snang ba skyed pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi bya ba mdzad pas na/ ye shes de'i bdag po la brten nas byung ba gdul bya'i skye bo'i snang ba la brten pa'i las rnams ni chos kyi sku'i 'phrin las yin no zhes ston pa la/ dus ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /ces pa'i don/ chos kyi sku bzhin du 'di'i 'phrin las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yang 'khor ba ji srid par bzhed pas mdzad pa yin no/ /las dngos ni/ rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas/ shar dang lho dang nub dang byang dang byang shar dang shar lho dang sto nub dang nub byang dang 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang sems chen po dag ched du bsams te sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu 'dong zhing dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar

byas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yenges su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang / cho 'phrul gsum po de dag gis dmyal ba'i sems can de dag la chos ston cing rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag zhi bar byas te/ yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis chos ston pa dang / byang sems chen po de dag byams pa chen po dang snying rje chen po dang dga' ba chen po dang btang snyoms chen pos chos ston te/ des dmyal ba'i sems can de dag byang sems chen po de la sems mos par byas shing dmyal ba chen po de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang / de dag nas rnam par rangs nas lha dang mi dag dang skal ba mnyam par skyes shing / rim gyis theg pa gsum gyis sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa mthong ngo zhes pa ni/ dmyal ba'i 'gro ba zhi bar mdzad pa dang / rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas/ shar dang sto dang nub dang byang dang byang shar dang shar lho dang sto nub dang nub byang dang 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ 7byang sems chen po dag byol song gi skye gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du bdag yongs su gtong bar byed cing / de la byang sems chen po de dag yan lag dang nying

༄༅/ /lag bcad cing btub ste phyogs bcur rnam par 'thor pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i sems can de dag gis byang sems chen po de dag gi sha zos nas/ de dag byang sems chen po de dag la byams pa 'thob pa/ de dag byams pa thob pa des byol song gi skye gnas nas rnam par ldang zhing / rnam par langs nas lha dang mi'i nang du skye ba dang / de dag tu skyes nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed pa dang / de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / de dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las chos thos te de bzhin nyid du nan tan byeng pa dang / de dag nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'am/ theg pa chen po'am/ theg pa gsum po de dag gis/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su rim gyis mya ngan las 'da' ba mthong ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang sems chen po gang bla med byang chub tu sems bskyed cing de bzhin nyid du nan tan byed pa de dag ni de ltar phan pa mang po byed pa'o zhes pa ni/ byol song gi skye gnas kyi 'gro ba zhi ba'i las dang / rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar dang lto dang nub dang byang dang byang shar dang shar lto dang lto nub dang nub byang dang 'og dang steng

gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ byang sems chen po sems can yi dwags kyi yul pa rnams kyi yul de dag na sdug bsngal ci snyed gcig yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu 'jil zhing ser sna spang ba'i phyir chos ston pa dang / de dag na sems can yi dwags kyi yul pa de dag byang sems chen po de dag la byams pa'i sems bskyed cing / yi dwags kyi skye gnas de dag nas rnam par ldang ba dang /de dag nas rnam par langs nas dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis lha dang mi'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ phung po ma lus pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom lngan 'das rnams dang nam yang dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba dag mthong ngo zhes pa ni yi dwags kyi 'gro ba zhi ba las dang / rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ phor dang lto dang nub dang byang dang byang shar dang shar lho dang lho nub dang nub byang dang 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi byed ma snyed dag na/ byang sems chen po rgya chen bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la chos ston pa dang / byang sems chen po de dag las de dag gis thos de thos nas/ theg pa gsum

༄༅/ /gyi rim gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa dang / 'da' ba dang / 'da' bar 'gyur ba mthong ste/ de la lha'i bu gang 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas shas cher myos pa de dag la gzhal med khang de dag 'bar bar snang bar byas shing de dag skyo bar gyur pa shes nas 'di skad du/ grogs po dag 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang bdag med pa dang mi brtan pa dang yid brtan du mi rung ba dang / 'du byed thams cad ni rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin na/ 'du byed rnams la su zhig yid 'bebs par gnas zhes chos ston to/ /rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar nas/ steng gi bar gyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gang na/ byang sems chen po rnams sems can gang tshangs pa'i lta ba mngon par zhen pa de dag la kye grogs po dag chos thams cad stong pa dang gsog dang gsob sha stag la ci zhig lta ba skyed ces lta ba'i rnam pa de dang bral bar mthong ste/ de ltar byang sems chen po rnams snying rje chen po la gnas shing sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /rab 'byor de ni ngo mtshar che ste byang sems chen po rnams kye rmad du byung ba'i chos so zhes pa ni/ lha'i 'gro ba zhi ba'i las dang / rab 'byor ngas yang 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis

'jig rten la rnam par gzigs na/ shar nas/ steng gi bar gyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na mi rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sdud pa mthong ste/ bzhi gang4zhe na/ sbyin pa dang tshig snyan pa dang don spyod dang don mthun pa'o/ /rab 'byor ci ltar na byang sems chen po sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang sems chen po sbyin pa gnyis kyis semasacan rnams sdud de gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dang chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /ji ltar na byang sems chos dang zang thing gi sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod po'i tshe gser ram dngul lam nor bu'am mu tig gam baiḍūrya nas bud med dam skyes pa'am rta'am glang po'am bdag yongs su gtang na 'di skad du/ kye ma sems can dag tshur shog /bdag nyid kyi dang 'dra bar bslang mi dgos par khyer cig long la dengs shig ces brjod do/ /des sbyin pa byin nas sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su gtong ngo / /la la ni bslab pa'i gnas lnga 'dzin du 'dzud do/ /la la ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong la nye bar gnas par bya'o/ /la la ni dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams la 'god do/ /la la ni bsam gtan dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa la 'god do zhes pa nas/

༄༅/ /la la ni byang chub dang lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar la yang dag par bskul lo/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe sems can rnams la zang zing gi sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing thabs mkhas pas bla na med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par 'god do/ /rab 'byor de ni byang sems chen po'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos so/ /rab 'byor ci ltar na byang sems yum la spyod pa'i tshe chos kyi sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor gnyis po 'di dag ni chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa gang zhe na/ 'jig rten pa'i chos brjod pa dang bshad pa dang ma nor bar bstan pa ste/ 'di ltar gtsang ba'i rnam par dang bsam gtan bzhi dang tshad med pa bzhi dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang mngon par shes pa lnga dang / gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i chos byis pa so so'i skye bo dag dang thun mong du gyur pa rnams te/ rab 'byor 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /rab 'byor byang sems chen po des 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa de btang nas rnam grangs du mas 'jig rten gyi chos ma nor bar blangs pa de las bskyod de/ bskyod nas thabs mkhas pas 'phags pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu dag la rab tu 'god do/ /de

la 'phags pa'i chos rnams ni gang / 'phags pa'i chos kyi 'bras bu ni gang zhe na/ 'phags pa'i chos zhes bya ba ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mo/ /'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu ni rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan gcig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang dgra bcom pa nyid de/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu shes pa nas/ btang snyoms chen po'i bar du shes pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang zag pa med pa dang / 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams shes pa ste/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi ye shes ma gtogs par de dag byang sems chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams so/ /byang sems chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu gang zhe na/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba ste/ 'di ni byang sems chen po'i 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi 'bras bu'o/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar lags/ byang sems chen pos rnam mkhyen nyid thob par 'gyur ram/ thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te byang sems chen pos rnam mkhyen nyid 'thob par 'gyur na/ byang sems chen po dang de bzhin

༄༅/ /gshegs pa la bye brag ni ci zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bye brag yod do/ /ci lta bu zhig mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang sems chen po ni rnam mkhyen nyid 'thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni ye shes brnyes pa zhes bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang la gnas shing chos thams cad la mun pa med pa 'thob pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems kyang gzhan la de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kyang gzhan zhes bya ba med de/ rab 'byor de ni byang sems chen po'i 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ de la brten nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa 'byung ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar byang sems chen po sems can rnams 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa la sbyor zhing thabs mkhas pas 'phags pa'i chos 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin pa la bkod nas rnam mkhyen nyid la 'god pa yin no zhes pa'i don/ mi'i 'gro ba zhi ba'i las te/ 'gro rnams zhi ba'i las dang ni zhes pa'i don/ chos kyi skus dang por 'gro ba bzang po dang bzang po ma yin pa la mngon par zhen pa med par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid 'gro ba rab tu zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po 'jig rtan las 'das pa'i chos kyi spyin pa so so'i skye bo thams cad thun mong ma yin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dran

pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang zhes pa nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid dang / mi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / gzungs kyi sgo lnga brgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnams te/ de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa zhes bya'o zhes pa nas/ rab 'byor ji ltar na byang sems chen po tshig snyan pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis sems can rnams sdud pa yin te/ 'di ltar sbyin pa nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis byang sems chen po de dag gis byang sems chen po snyan par smra bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis dge ba'i chos thams cad ma bsdus pa med de/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang sems chen po tshig snya na par smra bas sems can rnams sdud do/ /rab 'byor ci ltar na byang sems chen pos don spyod pa dang don mthun pas sems can rnams sdud pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis don byas pa dang don mthun pas sems can rnams sdud do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag gis dge ba'i chos thams cad ma bsdus pa med de/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang

༄༅/ /sems chen po don byas pa dang don mthun pas sems can rnams sdud do/ /rab 'byor de yang byang sems chen po rnams kyi ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i chos so zhes pa'i don/ bsdu rnams bzhi la 'god pa dang zhes pa'i don/ de nas sbyin pa la sogs pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bkod/ rgol ba ni/ de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te de ltar chos kyi dbyings la 'da' ba yang ma mchis / de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' la'ang 'da' ba ma mchis na ci lags/ 'o na gzugs nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar yang gzhan la chos kyi dbyings kyang gzhan/ yang dag pa'i mtha' yang gzhan zhig lags sam/ lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar yang gzhan la chos kyi dbyings kyang gzhan de bzhin nyid kyang gzhan/ yang dag pa'i mtha' yang gzhan ma yin rgol ba ni/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar gzugs nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar yang gzhan la chos kyi dbyings kyang gzhan/ de bzhin nyid kyang gzhan yang dag pa'i mtha' yang gzhan ma lags na/ 'o na ji ltar chos rnams 'bras bu rnam par 'god cing / nag po'i chos rnams kyi rnam par smin pa nag po ni sems can dmyal ba dang byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang /

dkar po'i chos rnams kyi rnam par smin pa dkar po ni lha dang mi/ dkar nag gi chos rnams kyi rnam par smin pa dkar nag gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba/ mi gnag cing dkar ba'i chos rnams kyi rnam par smin pa mi gnag cing dkar ba ni rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang rang byang chub dang bla med byang chub po zhes bgyi bar rnam par 'god par 'gyur / lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor kun rdzob kyi bden pa tshad mar byas te 'bras bu rnam par dgod pa bstan gyi/ don dam pa'i bden pas ni 'bras bu rnam par dgod pa bstan par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos de ni rnam par rtag tu med pa brjod du med pa tha snyad med pa ste/ 'di ltar ming bden pa dang / gzugs bden pa dang / skye ba dang 'gag pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba med pa ste/ 'di ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /rgol ba ni/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te de ltar kun rdzob kyi bden pa nye bar bzung ste 'bras bu rnam par 'god pa lags kyi don dam pa'i bden pas ma lags na/ byis pa so so'i skye bo'i thams cad kyang rgyun du zhugs pa nas/ bla med byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /lan ni/ bcom ldana'adas kyis bka' stsal

༄༅/ /pa / rab 'byor ci byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams kun rdzob kyi bden pa'am don dam gyi bden pa shes sam/ gal te shes na de dag kyang rgyun du zhugs pa nas/ bla med byang chub tu rnam par dgod par 'gyur na/ rab 'byor byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la lam yang med/ lam rnam par dgod pa yang med/ lam sgom pa yang med par byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams la 'bras bu rnam par dgod pa lta ga las 'ong /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i gang zag la ni lam yang yod/ sgom pa yang yod pas na de'i phyir 'phags pa'i gang zag de dag la 'bras bu rnam par dgod pa yod do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/lam bsgoms pas 'bras bu thob pa'am/ thob par bgyi ba mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin te/ lam bsgoms pas 'bras bu thob pa'am 'bras bu thob par bya ba med do/ /rab 'byor lam bsgoms pas kyang 'bras bu 'thob pa med do/ /lam gyis 'bras bu thob par bya ba yang med do/ /lam la ma gnas par yang 'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ thabasamakhas pas sems can rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par 'god par byed de/ 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyi khams res bcad cing 'bras bu rnam par 'god par mi byed

do / /rgol ba ni/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te de ltar 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams ris su bcad cing 'bras bu rnam par 'god pa ma mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ni kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs pas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / gnod sems bsrabs pas lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /'og ma'i cha can gyi kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pas phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /bla ma'i cha can gyi kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /gang ci yang rung ste kun 'byung gi chos de dag thams cad 'gog pa'i chos can du 'du shes pas rang byang chub bo/ /bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo zhes gsungs na/ bcom ldan 'das/ ris su bcad cing 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam par bzhag pa ma mchis na/ gsungs pa'i don de bdag gis ci ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub bam bla med byang chub 'dus byas sam/ 'on te 'dus ma byas yin/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'dus ma byas

༄༅/ /pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni 'dus ma bgyis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'o na 'dus ma byas kyi chos la ris su bcad pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor ci snyam du sems/ gang gi tshe rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams 'di lta ste/mtshan nyid med pa mtshan nyid gcig tu chud par gyur na/ de'i tshe 'dus byas sam 'dus ma byas zhes chos gang la yang ris su bcad pa yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems chen po yang yum la spyod pa'i tshe 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid nas/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du nye bar bzung ste/sems can rnams la ris su bcad pas chos mi ston to/ /de bdag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nas/ rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar ram chos gang la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /de mngon par zhen pa med pas gang la yang chags pa med do zhes sogs kyi don/ kun nas nyon mongs bcas pa yi/ /rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang / /zhes pa'i don/ de nas thos pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i shes pas mi mthun pa'i

phyogs dor ba dang gnyen po blang bar bya ba'i sgo nas rtogs par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems chen po yang yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos kyi dbyings su ma gtogs pa'i chos gang yang mi mthong ste/thabs mkhas pas sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed kyang sems can du mi dmigs sems can du gdags pa yang mi dmigs te zhes pa'i don/ sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi/ don la dgod ces pa'i don / de nas sgyu ma mkhan bzhin du rjes su chags pa la sogs pas rnam par dben pa nyid kyis sems can gyi don te gzhan gyi don byams pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba'i bdag nyid la bkod do/ /de bdag kyang sbyin pa gtong ba yin/ gzhan yang sbyin pa la yang dag par bskul ba yin/ sbyin pa'i legs pa brjod pa yin/ sems can gzhan yang sbyin pa gtong ba de dag gi legs pa brjod cing mthun bas dga' bar spyod pa yin/ de bzhin du tshul khrims bsrung ba dang / bzod pa bsgom pa dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / shes rab bsgom pa la sbyar nas sasu ngas pa'i don/pha rol phyin drug la dgod ces pa'i don/ de'i rjes la rang gi don 'bor gsum rnam par dag pas rab tu phye ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la goms pa la dgod do/ /bdag kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag

ra༅༅/ /par 'dzin pa yin/ gzhan yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la yang dag par bskul ba yin/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi legs pa brjod pa yin/ sems can gzhan gang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par 'dzin pa de dag gi legs pa brjod cing mthun pas dga' bar spyod pa yin/ de bzhin du bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong dang / bsam gtan bzhi nas/sems can gzhan yang skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad drozang po brgyad cu sgrub pa de dag gi legs pa brjod cing mthun pas dga' bar spyod pa yin zhes pa'i don/ sangs rgyas lam la dgod ces pa'i don/ de'i 'og tu rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi mtshan nyid sangs rgyas kyi lam ste dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la dgod do/ /rab 'byor gal te chos kyi dbyings sngon ji lta bar phyis kyang de bzhin bar yang de bzhin ma yin du zin na ni/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe thabs mkhas pas chos kyi dbyings sbyor bar mi byed cing sems can rnams la chos kyi dbyings ston par mi 'gyur/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag parngo me 'gyur te/ rab 'byor chos kyi dbyengs de sngon ji lta bar chos phyis kyang de bzhin bar du yang de bzhin pas/ de'i phyir byang sems chen po yang

yum la spyod pa'i tshe thabs mkhas pas sems can rnams la chos kyi dbyings ston to/ /sems can rnams kyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod do/ /sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do zhes sogs kyi don/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid la dgod ces pa'i don/ de nas chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid goms pa la dgod do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin te/ byang chub ni gnyis su dbyer med pa ste gnyis la spyod pa la byang chub med do/ /rab 'byor byang chub ni gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med par byang sems chen po'i byang chub ni byang chub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa'o zhes bya bar gnyis su bya ba la mi byed do/ /byang sems chen po'i byang chub de ni gzugs la mi byed do zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la mi spyod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni bdag gam bdag gir bya ba med pa ste/ bdag gis gzugs la spyad par bya'o zhe'am/ bdag dang bdag gir bya ba med de zhes pa nas/ bdag gis bla med byang chub kyi bar la spyad par mi bya'o zhe'am/ bdag gi bla med byang chub bo zhes bya bar bdag dang bdag gir bya ba med de/ byang sems chen po'i byang chub ni 'dzin pa la mi spyod mi 'dzin pa la mi spyod do/ /rab 'byor

༄༅/ /gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te de ltar byang sems chen po'i byang chub 'dzin pa la'ang mi spyod/ mi 'dzin pa la'ang mi spyod na/ byang sems chen po'i byang chub ci la spyod pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ de bzhin gshegs pas sprul pa'i byang chub 'dzin pa'am/ mi 'dzin pa'am/ ci la yang spyod pa yod dam/ dgra bcom pa'i rmi lam gyi blo 'dzin pa'am/ mi 'dzin pa gang la stod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags te/ dgra bcom pa yong yang nyal ba ma mchis na/ de rmi lam gyi blo 'dzin pa'am mi 'dzin pa la spyod par 'gyur ba lta ga la mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems chen po'i byang chub kyang 'dzin pa'am mi 'dzin pa la spyod pa med do zhes sogs kyi don/ gnyis zad la dgod ces pa'i don/ de'i rjes la/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas/ sa dang po chos kyi dbyings kun tu 'gro ba rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'i chos la dgod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor de yang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du btags pa'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na byang sems chen po bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'i don dam par ni gzugs sam zhes pa nas/ bla med byang chub kyi bar ram gang byang chub tu spyod pa'i chos de lta

bu yang med de/ chos de dag thams cad ni 'jig rten gyi tha snyad nye bar bzung ste btags pa yin gyi don dam par ni ma yin no/ /de bas na byang sems chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste byang chub tu spyod kyang sems de dag mi dmigs te/ sems can rnams dang byang chub dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmigs so zhes sogs kyi don/ brda la dgod ces pa'i don de nas tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu gyur pas sa gnyis pa la sogs pa la tshul khrims la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyinapa'i chos thams cad brdar btags pa'i shes pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /rgol ba ni/ de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/bcom ldan 'das/ gal te byang sems chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la spyod pas byang chub kyi lam rdzogs par bgyis kyang / bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba'i skal ba ma mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de ci ltar byang sems chen po bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba lags/ lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor nam byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe thabs mkhas pas sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang yum bsgom yang / sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i bdag po dang

༄༅/ /len pa yang mi dmigs/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa yang mi dmigs/ bzod pa dang bzod pa dang ldan pa yang mi dmigs/ brtson 'grus dang brtson 'grus rtsom pa yang mi dmigs/ bsam gtan dang bsam gtan pa yang mi dmigs/ shes rab dang shes rab dang ldan pa yang mi dmigs/ chos de dag las gzhan du yang mi spyod na/ de'i tshe byang sems chen po byang chub kyi lam 'thob par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po yum la de ltar spyod na thabs mkhas pas bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nam byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar la spyod kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bsgom pa yang mi dmigs/ chos de gnyis las gzhan du yang mi spyod na/ de'i tshe byang sems chen po byang chub kyi lam 'thob par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po yum la de ltar spyod na thabs mkhas pas bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o zhes sogs kyi don/ dmigs pa med pa la dgod ces pa'i don/ de bzhin du rim gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas sa drug pa la shes pa dang shes bya'i dngos por mngon par ma zhen pa'i mtshan nyid chos thams cad dmigs su med pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /gsol pa/ bcom

ldan 'das/ thams mkhas pa gang gis byang sems chen po chos thams cad dngos po med par mthong nas/ bla med byang chub tu yang dag par 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas pa de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang dang gang la thogs par 'gyur ba'i dngos po'am/ gyur nas zhus par 'gyur ba'am/ gyur nas sgyid lugs par 'gyur ba'am/ gyur nas tshe chad par 'gyur ba'am/ gyur nas le lor 'gyur ba'i dngos po yang dag par rjes su mthong ste/ shā ri'i bu sems can rnams rmongs pas phung po dang skye mched dang khams dang rten 'brel dang rten 'brel gyi chos zhes bya bar mngon par zhen pa mngon par rtogs par chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o/ /srog med pa'i srog dang bral ba'o/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid do/ /rang bzhin stong pa'o/ /rang gis stong pa'o/ /de lta bas na byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong par yang dag par rjes su mthong bas/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po lta bu'i lus byin gyis brlabs nas sems can rnams la chos ston te/ sems can gang ser sna can du gyur pa de dag la sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims ngan pa can rnams la tshul khrims dang / gnod sems can

༄༅/ /rnams la bzod pa dang / le lo can rnams la brtson 'grus dang / sems g.yeng ba rnams la ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab 'chal ba rnams la shes rab kyi gtam byed do/ /gang gi tshe sems can de dag sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab la bkod par gyur pa de'i tshe/ de las gong du sems can de dag la 'phags pa'i gtam 'byung bar 'gyur gang gis rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang rang byang chub dang rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar du thob par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gtam byed do zhes sogs kyi don/lus can rnams ni yongs smin la dgod ces pa'i don/ de'i 'og tu sa bdun pa la thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis sems can yongs su smin par byed pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen pos byang chub kyi lam gang la spyad de/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bgyi ba'i byang sems chen po'i byang chub kyi lam gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chon po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco

brgyad la spyod cing sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do zhes sogs kyi don/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam la dgod ces pa'i don/ de nas stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis sa brgyad pa la nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam la dgod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor de la byang sems chen po byang chub kyi lam la spyod pas thog ma nyid du 'di ltar yongs su brtag par bya ste/ mngon par 'du bya ba ma gtogs par 'di la chos gang yang ngo bo nyid dmigs su med do zhes bya bar yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /de la chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid la de ltar rtogs pas pha rol tu phyin pa rnams nas/ bla med byang chub kyi bar ram chos gang la yang mngon par chags par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid kyis chos thams cad kyis stong pa ste/ stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen par mi 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid kyang dmigs su med na gang stong pa nyid la mngon par zhen par 'gyur ba lta ci smos te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang sems chen po chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med par chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med par chos thams cad kyis rnam par spyod do zhes sogs kyi don/ mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa la

༄tsho/ /dgod ces pa'i don/ de nas de nyid la chos thams cad mngon par zhen pa spangs pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ skyes par gyur pa'i lam gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ ma yin no/ /'o na ma skyes pa'i lam gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags sam/ ma yin no/ /'o na skyes kyang skyes la ma skyes kyang ma skyes pa'i lam gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags sam/ ma yin no/ /'o na skyes pa yang ma lags ma skyes pa yang ma lags pa'i lam gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur ba lags sam/ ma yin no/ /'o na ci ltar byang chub thob par 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub ni lam gyis thob par yang ma yin lam ma yin pas thob pa yang ma yin te/ byang chub nyid kyang lam mo lam nyid kyang byang chub bo/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das / gal te de ltar byang chub nyid kyang lam la lam nyid kyang byang chub lags na/ byang sems chen pos byang chub snga ma nas kyang thob par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas su skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / thugs rje chen po dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyis

brjod do zhesaci'i slad du bstan/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ sangs rgyas shig byang chub thob par byed pa yin nam/ de ni ma lags so/ /sangs rgyas ni byang chub thob par mi mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang byang chub bo byang chub nyid kyang sangs rgyas so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang khyod kyis 'di skad du/ byang sems chen pos byang chub snga nas thob par 'gyur ro zhes smras pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po ni pha rol tu phyin pa rnams nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi bar yongs su rdzogs par byas shing rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/ bla med byang chub tu sangs rgyas phyin chad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzigs pa/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba zhes bya'o zhes pa'i don/ byang chub thob la dgod ces pa'i don / de'i rjes la sa dgu pa la smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mthus byang chub thob pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te chos thamasacad rang bzhin gyis dben pa la gnas na/ ce ltar byang sems chen po sangs rgyas kye zhing yongs su dag par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar

༄༅/ /bzung ste/ bdag dang gzhan gyi lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len yongs su sbyang ste/ de yongs su dag par byas pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lus kyi las mi dge ba srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang 'dod par log par g.yem pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi gnas ngan len to/ /ngag gis las mi dge ba rdzun du smra ba dang phra ma dang zhe gcod pa'i tshig 'khyal ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i ngag gi gnas ngan len to/ /yid kyi las mi dge ba chags sems dang gnod sems dang log par lta ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i yid kyi gnas ngan len to/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang ser sna dang tshul khrims ngan pa dang 'byug pa dang le lo dang g.yeng ba dang mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang shes rab 'chal ba'i sems ni byang chub sems dpa'i yid kyi gnas ngan len to/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi nas/ smon pa med pa dang bral ba ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ngan len to/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang rgyun du zhugs pa nas/ rang byang chub mngon du byed de la 'dod pa skyed pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ngan len to/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang gzugs kyi 'du

shes ni gnas ngan len te zhes pa nas/ 'dus ma byas kyi 'du shes ni gnas ngan len te/ rab 'byor de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len to zhes pa nas/ 'dus ma byas kyi 'du shes ni gnas ngan len to/ /rab 'byor de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len te/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe gnas ngan len de thams cad rnam par spangs shing / bdag kyang sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing gzhan yang spyin pa la yang dag par bskul te de zas 'dod pa la zas yongs su gtong ngo zhes pa nas/ mi'i rkyen dang yo byad gang ci yang rung ba'i bar du 'dod pa la ni de dag yongs su gtong ste/ gzhan yang de la yang dag par bskul zhing rab tu 'god de/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su bsngo'o/ /de bdag nyid kyang tshul khrims bsrung ngo / /bzod pa bsgom mo/ /brtson 'grus brtsam mo/ /bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug go /shes rab bsgom mo/ /gzhan yang de dag la yang dag par bskul zhing 'jog go /'dul lo/ /rab tu 'god do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /stong

༄༅/ /gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis yongs su bkang zhing dkon mchog gsum la 'bul bar byed kyang / 'di snyam du dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las grub par gyur cig ces bya bar sems bskyed do zhes sogs kyi don/ sangs rgyas zhing rnam par dag la dgod ces pa'i don/ de'i 'og tu ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs kyis/sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs rnam par dag pa la bkod par mdzad do/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems chen po nges zhes bgyi ba'am ma nges zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po ni nges pa ste ma nges pa ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ nyan thos kyi phung po'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi phung po'am/ phung po gang nges pa lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi phung po nges pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas kyi phung por nges pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems chen po ni nges zhes bgyi'am/ 'on tam phyor mi ldog pa nges zhes bgyi'am/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa nges zhes bgyi'am/ srid pa tha ma pa nges zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems chen po ni nges pa'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa ni nges pa ni/ /srid pa gcig gis thogs pa ni nges pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/nges pa'i byang sems chen po ni ngan song rnams su skye bar mi tsho'agyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin te/ rab 'byor ngas byang sems chen po ni ngan song du mi skye'o/ /rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ brgyad pa'am rgyun du zhugs pa'am lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'am phyir mi 'ong ba'am dgra bcom pa'am rang sangs rgyas ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems chen po gang sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ sbyin pa gtong ba dang / tshul khrims srung ba dang / bzod pa sgrub pa dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / shes rab sgom pa dang / mi dge ba'i chos spong ba'i don du gnas pa de ni ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med do/ /lha tshe ring por skye ba'i gnas med do zhes sogs kyi don/ nges pa la dgod ces pa'i don/ de nas yang de nyid la skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i rang gi ngo bo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu so sor nges pa la

༄tsho/ /dgod par mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen po ni chos dkar po gang dang gang la gnas shing de lta bu'i thabs mkhas pa bgyid kyang las de lta bus mi gsor spyod pa lags/ bka' stsal pa / rab 'byor byang sems chen po yum la gnas shing de lta bu'i thabs mkhas pa la spyod do/ /thabs mkhas pa de dag gi phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu sems can rnams kyi don byed kyang des de la gang la reg par 'gyur ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di byang sems chen pos gang reg par byed pa dang / gang gis reg par bya ba dang / gang la reg par bya ba de lta bu'i chos gsum po de dag thams cad mi dmigs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos gsum po de dag thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong pas stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid la reg par mi byed do/ /stong pa nyid kyis chos gang la yang reg par mi 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid kyang reg par bya ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid mi dmigs so/ /de ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid de/ de la gnas shing byang sems chen po bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci lags byang sems chen po chos gzhan la mi gnas shing rnam pa de lta bu'i thabs mkhas pa dang spyod pa lags sam/ bka'

stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos gang yum gyi khongs su ma chud pa de lta bu yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de lta yum ngo bo nyid kyis stong na ji ltar yum gyi khongs su chos thams cad 'du ba lags/bcom ldan 'das/ stong pa nyid la ni chos gang la yang khongs su chud pa'am khongs su ma chud pa zhes bgyi ba ma mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis mi stong ngam/ stong ngo chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis stong na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ma 'dus sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de de lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na khyod kyis 'di ltar/ byang sems chen po ni yum la gnas shing de lta bu'i thabs mkhas pa la spyod par rig par bya'o zhes pa'i don/ sems can don ni tshad med la dgod ces pa'i don/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gyi don la dgod par mdzad do/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod cing chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gnas te mngon par shes pa gang la gnas shing phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gang du 'chi ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed

༄tsho/ /gcig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang chos ston pa de dag la bsnyen bkur bgyid pa dang / chos nyan cing sangs rgyas bcom ldan de dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed bas mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par sgrub pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong par mthong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang ngo bo nyid kyis stong par mthong ngo / /gzhan du na ming dang brdar btags pa nye bar bzung zhing bstan pa ma gtogs te btags pa kun kyang ngo bo nyid kyis stong ngo / /gal te 'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang ngo bo nyid kyis mi stong la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang ngo bo nyid kyis mi stong ste gdags pa'i rgyu de dag kyang ngo bo nyid kyis mi stong pa zhig yin na ni/ nyi tshe'i stong pa nyid du 'gyur te de yang stong pa nyid du 'gyur te/de yang stong pa nyi tshe ba ma yin no/ /de'i phyir chos thams cad chos thams cad kyis stong ste/ de nyid kyi phyir byang sems chen po thabs mkhas pas yum la spyod cing mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par

bsgrubs te/ mngon par shes pa de dag la gnas shing lha'i mig dang rna ba dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa thang pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang shi 'pho dang skye ba shes pa mngon par bsgrubs te/mngon par shes pa med par byang sems chen pos bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar byang sems chen po'i byang chub ni mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin par 'durme te/mngon par shes pa de dag las byang chub yongs su btsal bar bya'o zhes sogs kyi don/ sangs rgyas bsten sogs yon tan la dgod ces pa'i don/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi drung du nye bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i yon tan la bkod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems chen po lam gyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs par bgyis shing bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i lam de gang las/rsha / bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dge ba'i chos thams cad ni byang sems chen po'i lam gyi yan lag go /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ lam gyi yan lag gang gis bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste dge ba'i chos sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la mi rtege cing

༄༅/ /de yongs su gtong ba'i tshe ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di ni sbyin pa'o/ /'di la gtang bar bya'o/ /bdag gis sbyin par bya'o zhes chos gsum po de dag la mi rtog pa ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ de dag dge ba'i chos tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyang de la mi rtog cing shes rab bsgom pa'i tshe ngo bo nyid kyi phyir 'di ni shes rab bo/ /bdag gis shes rab bsgom mo/ /'di'i don du shes rab sgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la mi rtog pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so / /sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang sems chen po dge ba'i chos stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhe dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhe dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang

mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la spyod kyang de la ma rtog cig /de sgom pa'i tshe ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi phyir 'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chosam 'dres pa rnams so/ /bdag gis de rnams bsgom par bya'o/ /'di'i don du de rnams sgom mo zhes gsum po de dag la mi rtog pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa gang gis bdag kyang 'khor ba las sgrol zhing gzhan yang sgrol ba 'di ni lam gyi yan lag dge ba'i chos so/ /dge ba'i chos de dag ni byang sems chen po'i bla med byang chub kyi lam ste lam des 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byang sems chen po rnams sems can tshad med pa de dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal bar gyur pa dang / rgal ba dang / brgal bar 'gyur ba ste/ lam de yang yongs su rdzogs par byas shing byang sems chen po rnam mkhyen nyid thob pa/ra byed do/ /de thob par byas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /de bskor te sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /de nas rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das/ gal te chos de

༄༅/ /dag byang sems chen po'i lags na sangs rgyas kyi chos gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gang 'di skad du gal te chos de dag byang sems chen po'i yin na sangs rgyas kyi chos gang yin zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang chos de dag nyid rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar zad de/ de rnam mkhyen nyid thob nas bag chags kyi mtshams spyor ba thams cad yongs su spong ngo / /de la byang sems chen po ni mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ste/ byang sems chen po dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la khyad par de yod do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na zhugs pa yang gzhan la 'bras bu la gnas pa'ang gzhan te de gnyis ka yang 'phags pa'i gang zag ma yin zhes mi bya'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang sems chen po ni bar chad med pa'i lam du zhugs pa yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes brnyesate/ de ni byang sems chen po dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khyad par ro zhes pa'i don/ byang chub yan lag la dgod ces pa'i

don / de lta bu'i rim pas/ yang de nyid la khyad par gyi lam gyi rang gi ngo bo byang chub mtha' dag 'dren par byed pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid byang chub kyi yan lag la dgod par mdzad/ rgol ba ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa lags na rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos de dag la/ 'di sems can dmyal ba dang byol song gi skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'o/ /'di ni lha dang mi'o/ /'di na brgyad pa'i sa dang rgyun du zhugs pa dang lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'o/ /'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so zhes bgyi bar khyad par dang rnam par dbye ba ci ltar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci ltar gang zag de dag dmigs su ma mchis pa de bzhin du las kyang dmigs su ma mchis/ ci ltar las dmigs su ma mchis pa de bzhin du las kyi rnam par smin pa yang dmigs su ma mchis so/ /lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin te chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa la las dang las kye rnam par smin pa mi dmigs so/ /rab 'byor gang ges rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i chos thams cad de ltar ma shes pa de dag ni ngan par spyad

༄0/ /pa'am / legs par spyad pa'am mi g.yo ba'i las mngon par 'du byed de/ de dag ngan par spyad pa'i las kyis ngan song gsum du lhung ngo / /legs par spyad pa'i las kyi lha dang mir skye'o/ /nyams pa med pa'i las kyis gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams su skye'o/ /de la byang sems chen po ni snyen pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad ces pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la spyad de nyams pa med pa'i spyod pas byang chub kyi lam bskyed nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin byang chub kyi yan lag gi 'khor dang ldan pa la mnyam par bzhag cing bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/ sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams kyi don byed de/ don byas nas ci nas kyang phyis chud zos shing rgyud lnga'i 'khor bar mi lhung ba de ltar don byed do zhes sogs kyi don/ las rnams ni chud mi za la dgod ces pa'i don/ las dang 'bras bur 'brel ba chud mi za ba la dgod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ gal te chos thams cad rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa lags na/ ji ltar byang sems chen po bla med byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las sems can rnams yongs su 'grol pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po bla med byang chub tu sangs rgyas te/ sdug bsngal dang kun

'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /mchod do/ /'jog go /'god do/ /'brel to/ /rnam par 'byed do/ /gsal bar byed do/ /yang dag par brjod do/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po 'dir dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos gang ji snyed pa gang gis dkon mchog gsum rnam par dgod pa thams cad yongs su 'dus te/ dkon mchog gsum 'jig rten du 'byung bas sems ske can rnams lam rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba las yongs su 'grol to/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam 'tshal bar yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur ram / 'on te sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam shes pas yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ste/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam gyis kyang ma yin no/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po de dag mnyam pa nyid gang yin pa de ni mya ngan las 'da' bar ngas gsungs te/sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam shes pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ma yin/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam gyis kyang ma yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/

༄༅/ /gang la sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam yang ma mchis/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam 'tshal ba yang ma mchis pa'i 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mnyam pa nyid ces bgyi ba de gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ de ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po de dag gi de bzhin nyid dang ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang chos kyi dbyings dang chos kyi gnas nyid dang chos skyon med pa nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha'/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyings dang / chos kyi dbyings mi 'phel mi 'grib par 'dug pa ste/ de'i phyir byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe bden pa khong du chud pa ji lta ba bzhin du bden pa khong du chud par bya ba'i don du spyod do zhes sogs kyi don/ bden mthong la dargod ces pa'i don/dngos po thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa dang / de nas byams pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ gal te chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das/de'i tshe yum la spyod pa'i byang sems chen po byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par 'tshal bas gzugs la ji ltar bslab par bgyi zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ de skad

ces gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang sems chen po byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal lo/ /byams pa byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la slob par 'dod pas gzugs ming tsam mo zhes bya bar bslab par bya'o zhes pa nas/ chos kyi chos rnamasakyi bar du ming tsam mo zhes bya bar bslab par bya'o zhes pa ras/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/dngos po med pa'i chos shig dngos po med pa'i chos thob par byed snyam mam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ltar na dngos po med pa gang yin pa dang lam gang yin pa'i chos de gnyis ka ldan pa yang ma yin mi ldan pa yang ma yin/ gzugs med pa bstan du med pa thogs pa med pa mtshan nyid gcig pa ste 'di ltar mtshan nyid med pa'o / /rab 'byor de la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe thabs mkhas pas sems can phyin ci log bzhis phung po lnga la mngon par zhen pa/ mi rtag pa la rtag pa'i 'du shes su gyur pa/ sdug bsngal ba la bde ba'i 'du shes su gyur pa/ bdag med pa la bdag gi 'du shes su gyur pa/ mi sdug pa la sdug pa'i 'du shes su gyur pa/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa rnams dngos po rnams las rnam par 'grol to zhes sogs kyi

༄༅/ /don / phyin ci log ni spangs pa la dgod ces pa'i don/ phyin ci log thams cad spangs pa la dgod par mdzad do/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ ci lags byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams gang la dngos po zhes mngon par zhen par gyur pa de lta bu'i dngos po de bzhin ma nor ba de bzhin zhes bgyi ba ma mchis sam/ de ste ma mchis na ni mngon par 'du bgyid par yang ji ltar 'gyur/ las des kyang lam rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba nas ci ste mi 'grol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor phyin ci log ma gtogs par gang la gnas te byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams las mngon par 'du byed pa'i dngos po ni chung ngu na skra'i rtse mo cha shas bzhag pa tsam yang med do/ /de bas na ci nas kyang don 'di gsal zhing rdzogs pa dang mkhas par shes par bya ba'i phyir khyod la dpe bshad do/ /de ci snyam du sems/ rmi lam du mthong ba la rmi lam mthong ba de gang la gnas shing 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas yongs su spyad pa de lta bu'i dngos po gang yang yod dam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ rmi lam nyid kyang ma mchis na rmi lam mthong ba de la gnas shing 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas yongagasu spyod pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te ma mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ji snyam du sems/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang /
